faq.q: What is a UGC style product photo template?
faq.a: It is a ready-made creator-style scene. You add your own product photo and generate a believable review, unboxing or demo shot without filming a creator.

faq.q: Do I need to write prompts to use these templates?
faq.a: No. Pick a style, upload your product photo and generate. Step two lets you add one line about the scene if you want.

faq.q: Who are these photo templates built for?
faq.a: Ecommerce sellers, marketers and agencies that need fresh social photos for ads, carousels and product pages without booking shoots.

faq.q: Which platforms are these photos made for?
faq.a: Square photos fit Instagram and TikTok posts, carousels and product galleries. Place them on a tall canvas in your editor for Stories.
Yes. Upload one product photo, choose a style and download the result. No editing or production experience is needed.

faq.q: Can I make several scenes from one product photo?
faq.a: Yes. Reuse the same photo across a routine, unboxing or demo scene, and generate a new version whenever you need another angle to test.

faq.q: How fast is a UGC style photo made?
faq.a: A photo is generated in minutes after you start the job, with no studio booking, creator schedule or reshoot in between.

faq.q: What does a creator-style photo cost?
faq.a: Each photo costs 24 credits, and the cost is shown before the job starts.

faq.q: Can I use these photos in paid ads?
faq.a: Yes. Downloads have no AIVideosUGC watermark and can run in your own ads, pages and posts. You remain responsible for ad claims and disclosures.

visual.overview: A creator-style photo shows your product in an everyday moment, ready for social ads and listing galleries.

steps.prompt: Use the uploaded photo as the product and keep its shape, clear bottle body, sage-green lid, loop handle and base exactly.
